Name: Geometry
Description: Specifies the base geometric shape used for the node. Determines the fundamental outline or profile of the generated object.

Flubs.Name: Circle
Flubs.Description: Generates a circular shape as the base geometry, resulting in round or elliptical forms.

Flubs.Name: Rectangle
Flubs.Description: Generates a rectangular shape as the base geometry, resulting in box-like or elongated forms.

Name: Sides
Description: Defines the number of sides for polygonal shapes. Higher values create shapes closer to a circle, while lower values produce more angular forms.

Name: Uniform
Description: When enabled, ensures that scaling and transformations are applied equally in all directions, maintaining the original proportions of the shape.

Name: Scale
Description: Controls the overall size of the shape, scaling it uniformly along both the X and Y axes.

Name: Scale X
Description: Adjusts the width of the shape by scaling it along the X axis independently.

Name: Scale Y
Description: Adjusts the height of the shape by scaling it along the Y axis independently.

Name: Thickness
Description: Specifies the thickness of the shape's outline or border, or the width of a ring for hollow shapes.

Name: Height
Description: Sets the vertical extent or elevation of the shape, often used to define extrusion or relief in terrain generation.

Name: X
Description: Sets the horizontal position or offset of the shape along the X axis.

Name: Y
Description: Sets the vertical position or offset of the shape along the Y axis.
